seo.metaDescription: Outcome-based delivery pods we run end to end. Explore Linkfields managed teams for specialist delivery, infrastructure management and ongoing support.
seo.keywords: managed teams, specialist talent, delivery teams

sections.heading: Balancing skills and expertise to make better teams
sections.body:
Combining features like teamwork, communication, objective setting and performance appraisals to form teams that function well, get along, and are highly productive.

Outcome-based delivery pods we run end to end. Agree the scope, responsibilities and delivery outcomes, then bring the right balance of skills and coordination to the work.

sections.heading: Bringing out the best in all employees

cards.title: Evaluation
cards.description: We begin with assessments and evaluations of the software/infrastructure that needs to be managed.

cards.title: Scope
cards.description: The scope, duration, and the budget of the engagement is decided upon with the client.

cards.title: Team selection
cards.description: A team is built with professionals whose skills sets match with the project requirements.

cards.title: SLA
cards.description: An SLA that summarises the conditions of the transition and the cooperation is signed with the client.

cards.title: Process
cards.description: On-demand or ongoing services are provided to the client in line with the SLA.

cards.title: Support
cards.description: Clients receive constant support from our experts during and after the service has been delivered.

sections.heading: Making administration future-ready
sections.description: Our combined offerings which are provided under team management provide an eclectic grouping of management systems that assist businesses and their employees by making the redundant tasks automated, and ensuring better pairings among teams.

items.title: Network management
items.description: We manage networks to guarantee that their architectures are correct and that resources are allocated as efficiently as possible.

items.title: Storage management
items.description: We manage data centres and stand-alone data storages to ensure that they are well-balanced and that stored data is protected.

items.title: System administration
items.description: We ensure that enterprise IT assets are available and secure (databases, physical and virtual servers, active directories, etc.).

items.title: Device management
items.description: We set up systems and technologies to ensure that corporate devices are constantly monitored, and security checked.
